deck.title: Mastering the Game of Allyship: 52-Card Prompt Deck

prompt.title: Inventory
prompt.primary_question: What resources do you already have?
prompt.clarification: (What do you claim? What have you dismissed as 'not enough'?)

gm_worldbuilding_hooks.geography: What resources does your land/body have?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.social: What resources does your community structure give you?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.history: What resources survived from before?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.magic: What invisible resources are already present?

shadow_work.year_1_surface: What do you see? What have you normalized as 'scarcity'?
shadow_work.year_2_shadow: What part of you has learned not to claim what's yours?
shadow_work.year_3_gift: How has your inventory taught you what's truly valuable?

prompt.title: Hidden Strength
prompt.primary_question: What strength do you have that your community needs?
prompt.clarification: (REVISED: Activist focus - what makes you valuable to the movement?)

gm_worldbuilding_hooks.geography: What strength does this land need right now?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.social: What strength is missing from your group?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.history: What strength did your ancestors have that you inherited?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.magic: What strength becomes visible when you stop hiding?

shadow_work.year_1_surface: What strength have you not named?
shadow_work.year_2_shadow: What part of you refuses to be strong? Why?
shadow_work.year_3_gift: What has your hidden strength been protecting?

prompt.title: What's Missing
prompt.primary_question: What resource gap stops you acting?
prompt.clarification: (Money? Skills? Community? Permission? Time?)

gm_worldbuilding_hooks.geography: What does your geography make inaccessible?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.social: Whose resources are gated from you?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.history: What historical scarcity are you protecting against?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.magic: What threshold do you need to cross?

shadow_work.year_1_surface: What's actually missing? (Be specific.)
shadow_work.year_2_shadow: What part of you created or accepted this gap?
shadow_work.year_3_gift: What has this scarcity taught you about your actual power?

prompt.title: Permission
prompt.primary_question: Who gets to decide what counts as enough?
prompt.clarification: (You? Your community? Systems of judgment?)

gm_worldbuilding_hooks.geography: What does your land say is 'enough'?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.social: Whose standards are you measuring against?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.history: Who taught you what's enough? How did that serve them?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.magic: What's the threshold between 'enough' and 'abundance'?

shadow_work.year_1_surface: Whose definition of 'enough' are you living inside?
shadow_work.year_2_shadow: What does it feel like to imagine defining 'enough' for yourself?
shadow_work.year_3_gift: How has your scarcity become your measure of integrity?

prompt.title: Inherited
prompt.primary_question: What resources did your family/community pass to you (seen or hidden)?
prompt.clarification: (Survival skills? Shame? Resilience? Money? Anger? Love? Secrets?)

gm_worldbuilding_hooks.geography: What survival skills did your land teach your people?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.social: What status or role did your people inherit?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.history: What did your people survive? What became your inheritance?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.magic: What gifts were passed down as curses? What curses are gifts?

shadow_work.year_1_surface: What visible and invisible things were passed to you?
shadow_work.year_2_shadow: Which inheritances are you trying to shed? Which are trying to shed you?
shadow_work.year_3_gift: How are you transforming what you inherited?

prompt.title: Cost
prompt.primary_question: What did accessing those resources cost you?
prompt.clarification: (Your voice? Your time? Your body? Your loyalty? Your dreams?)

gm_worldbuilding_hooks.geography: What did your land demand you give up?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.social: What did you sacrifice to survive in this power structure?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.history: What did your ancestors give up to pass this to you?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.magic: What price have you agreed to pay without naming it?

shadow_work.year_1_surface: What's the actual cost you paid?
shadow_work.year_2_shadow: What part of you agreed to this price? What convinced you it was worth it?
shadow_work.year_3_gift: What has your sacrifice taught you about what you truly value?

prompt.title: Hoarding
prompt.primary_question: What are you holding that isn't yours to keep?
prompt.clarification: (Anger? Secrets? Responsibility? Guilt? Space? Resources meant to be shared?)

gm_worldbuilding_hooks.geography: What does the land want to circulate that you're holding?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.social: What responsibility are you carrying that isn't yours?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.history: What were you taught to hoard? Why?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.magic: What becomes free when you let go?

shadow_work.year_1_surface: What are you holding? Why?
shadow_work.year_2_shadow: What fear is underneath the hoarding?
shadow_work.year_3_gift: What trust is possible on the other side of release?

prompt.title: Reciprocity
prompt.primary_question: How do you want to be in relationship with what you have?
prompt.clarification: (Gratitude? Stewardship? Generosity? Accountability?)

gm_worldbuilding_hooks.geography: What does reciprocal relationship with your land look like?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.social: How do you want to relate to your community through what you have?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.history: How do you honor what was given by giving forward?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.magic: What becomes possible when you see what you have as gift?

shadow_work.year_1_surface: What does right relationship feel like?
shadow_work.year_2_shadow: What blocks you from generosity? What does scarcity protect?
shadow_work.year_3_gift: How has your journey transformed you?

prompt.title: Threshold
prompt.primary_question: What resource shift marks your readiness to move?
prompt.clarification: (What's the signal? The permission? The preparation?)

gm_worldbuilding_hooks.geography: What season shift calls you to move?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.social: What community signal tells you it's time?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.history: What moment are you waiting for?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.magic: What crosses the threshold with you?

shadow_work.year_1_surface: What would make you ready?
shadow_work.year_2_shadow: What part of you is waiting for permission? Why?
shadow_work.year_3_gift: How have you learned to recognize your own readiness?

prompt.title: Voice
prompt.primary_question: What do you need to say out loud?
prompt.clarification: (The request? The boundary? The gratitude? The truth?)

gm_worldbuilding_hooks.geography: What does your land need to hear you say?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.social: Who needs to hear this from you?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.history: What silence are you breaking?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.magic: What becomes possible when you speak?

shadow_work.year_1_surface: What's been unsaid?
shadow_work.year_2_shadow: What are you afraid will happen if you speak?
shadow_work.year_3_gift: What strength does your voice carry now?

prompt.title: Claim
prompt.primary_question: What are you claiming as yours?
prompt.clarification: (Power? Space? Ancestry? Skill? Right? Responsibility?)

gm_worldbuilding_hooks.geography: What land are you claiming?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.social: What place/role are you taking in your community?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.history: What inheritance are you accepting?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.magic: What becomes visible when you claim it?

shadow_work.year_1_surface: What will you claim publicly?
shadow_work.year_2_shadow: What are you afraid to claim? Why don't you think you deserve it?
shadow_work.year_3_gift: What does claiming this teach you about power?

prompt.title: Generosity
prompt.primary_question: What are you willing to give to this movement?
prompt.clarification: (REVISED: Active commitment - what's your gift?)

gm_worldbuilding_hooks.geography: What does this land need from you?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.social: What gift does your community need?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.history: What are you giving forward?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.magic: What becomes abundant when you give?

shadow_work.year_1_surface: What's your gift? What are you willing to risk?
shadow_work.year_2_shadow: What fears come up around giving?
shadow_work.year_3_gift: How has giving transformed your understanding of abundance?

prompt.title: Stewardship
prompt.primary_question: What resource will you tend in the next season?
prompt.clarification: (Land? Relationships? Skills? Community? Your own body/spirit?)

gm_worldbuilding_hooks.geography: What part of your land will you tend?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.social: What relationships will you steward?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.history: How are you honoring what came before?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.magic: What grows when you tend it with intention?

shadow_work.year_1_surface: What will you commit to tending?
shadow_work.year_2_shadow: What are you willing to show up for consistently?
shadow_work.year_3_gift: How has your tending changed you and what you tend?

prompt.title: Circle
prompt.primary_question: Who's in your circle of trust?
prompt.clarification: (Who's missing? Who's been excluded?)

gm_worldbuilding_hooks.geography: Who does your geography bring together?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.social: What existing relationships do you already have?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.history: Who has stood with your people before?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.magic: What draws people into circle together?

shadow_work.year_1_surface: Who's in? Who's out? Why?
shadow_work.year_2_shadow: What loneliness have you accepted as normal?
shadow_work.year_3_gift: How has your circle changed you?

prompt.title: Difference
prompt.primary_question: What makes you see the world differently than those around you?
prompt.clarification: (Identity? Experience? Analysis? Perspective? Outsider status?)

gm_worldbuilding_hooks.geography: What different view does your position in the land give you?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.social: What makes your perspective valuable and unwelcome?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.history: What history do you hold that others don't?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.magic: What sight has been given to you?

shadow_work.year_1_surface: What makes you different? What do you see?
shadow_work.year_2_shadow: How have you been punished for seeing differently?
shadow_work.year_3_gift: What has your difference taught you about truth?

prompt.title: Fracture
prompt.primary_question: Where is your group fractured?
prompt.clarification: (What's broken? What divides you? What fault line is showing?)

gm_worldbuilding_hooks.geography: What geographical lines are fracturing your group?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.social: What power divides are showing?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.history: What old wounds are reopening?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.magic: What becomes visible at the fracture point?

shadow_work.year_1_surface: Where does your group break? Who's on which side?
shadow_work.year_2_shadow: What part of you is responsible for this fracture?
shadow_work.year_3_gift: What have you learned about resilience from this breaking?

prompt.title: Belonging
prompt.primary_question: Where do you know you belong?
prompt.clarification: (Who claims you? Where are you claimed?)

gm_worldbuilding_hooks.geography: What place claims you as belonging?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.social: Who claims you as theirs?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.history: What people before you belong to this too?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.magic: What threshold brings you home?

shadow_work.year_1_surface: Where do you belong? How do you know?
shadow_work.year_2_shadow: What belonging have you been denied?
shadow_work.year_3_gift: How does belonging change what you're capable of?

prompt.title: Influence
prompt.primary_question: Who has power over your organizing and you haven't named?
prompt.clarification: (REVISED: Power analysis - who's actually influencing the group?)

gm_worldbuilding_hooks.geography: What geographic power shapes your group?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.social: Who wields unspoken power in your circle?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.history: What historical figures influence your movement now?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.magic: What unseen forces shape your organizing?

shadow_work.year_1_surface: Who influences you invisibly?
shadow_work.year_2_shadow: What power do you pretend isn't there?
shadow_work.year_3_gift: How can you work with power explicitly instead of denial?

prompt.title: Rupture
prompt.primary_question: When did you disappoint someone you organize with?
prompt.clarification: (What went wrong? What did you do or not do?)

gm_worldbuilding_hooks.geography: How did your location/resources fail someone?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.social: What promise to your community did you break?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.history: What pattern of betrayal are you repeating?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.magic: What becomes possible through honest reckoning?

shadow_work.year_1_surface: Who did you let down? How?
shadow_work.year_2_shadow: What part of you was unavailable to them?
shadow_work.year_3_gift: How have you become more trustworthy through this?

prompt.title: Power
prompt.primary_question: What power are you afraid to claim in your group?
prompt.clarification: (Voice? Leadership? Decision-making? Resources? Vision?)

gm_worldbuilding_hooks.geography: What power does this place offer you?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.social: What power does your position give you to wield?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.history: What power did your people have that was stolen?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.magic: What power awakens when you claim it?

shadow_work.year_1_surface: What power do you have that scares you?
shadow_work.year_2_shadow: What happens if you claim it? What will people think?
shadow_work.year_3_gift: How has claiming power changed your relationships?

prompt.title: Repair
prompt.primary_question: What broken thing in your community are you tending?
prompt.clarification: (What relationship? What trust? What shared understanding?)

gm_worldbuilding_hooks.geography: What land needs tending and repair?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.social: What relationship wounds are you holding?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.history: What old hurts still need healing?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.magic: What becomes whole again when you tend it?

shadow_work.year_1_surface: What's broken that you can hold?
shadow_work.year_2_shadow: What part of you wants to give up on repair?
shadow_work.year_3_gift: What have you learned about resilience from tending this?

prompt.title: Emergence
prompt.primary_question: Who in your circle is becoming someone new?
prompt.clarification: (Who's growing? Who's waking up? Who's stepping into power?)

gm_worldbuilding_hooks.geography: Who is your land calling to become?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.social: Who's transformation threatens the old structure?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.history: Who's stepping into their ancestors' power?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.magic: What's emerging that wants to be seen?

shadow_work.year_1_surface: Who is changing in your circle?
shadow_work.year_2_shadow: What in their emergence triggers you?
shadow_work.year_3_gift: How has witnessing their growth changed you?

prompt.title: Accountability
prompt.primary_question: How do you want to be called in?
prompt.clarification: (What feedback do you need? Who can tell you the truth?)

gm_worldbuilding_hooks.geography: Who in your region can speak truth to you?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.social: What community feedback do you need to hear?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.history: What accountability traditions do you belong to?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.magic: What truth-telling transforms you?

shadow_work.year_1_surface: Who can you trust to tell you hard things?
shadow_work.year_2_shadow: What makes you defensive when called in?
shadow_work.year_3_gift: How has being held accountable deepened your integrity?

prompt.title: Boundary
prompt.primary_question: What boundary are you drawing in your organizing?
prompt.clarification: (What are you protecting? What's non-negotiable? What line won't you cross?)

gm_worldbuilding_hooks.geography: What land/space is yours to protect?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.social: What boundaries does your community need from you?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.history: What boundaries were violated in your people's history?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.magic: What becomes protected when you draw this line?

shadow_work.year_1_surface: What boundary must you set?
shadow_work.year_2_shadow: What will you lose by holding this boundary?
shadow_work.year_3_gift: How does this boundary serve the whole movement?

prompt.title: Covenant
prompt.primary_question: What do you pledge to your people?
prompt.clarification: (What's your commitment? What do they depend on you for?)

gm_worldbuilding_hooks.geography: What are you pledging to this land?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.social: What covenant do your people need from you?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.history: What pledges did your ancestors make that you honor?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.magic: What becomes real when you pledge it?

shadow_work.year_1_surface: What will you promise?
shadow_work.year_2_shadow: What about this pledge scares you?
shadow_work.year_3_gift: How has keeping this covenant changed you?

prompt.title: Momentum
prompt.primary_question: What practice will you keep going with them?
prompt.clarification: (What ritual? What routine? What steady thing holds you together?)

gm_worldbuilding_hooks.geography: What seasonal rhythm will you return to?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.social: What group practice holds you in relationship?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.history: What traditions are you carrying forward?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.magic: What practice opens the threshold to deepening?

shadow_work.year_1_surface: What will you commit to doing together?
shadow_work.year_2_shadow: What part of you wants to stop showing up?
shadow_work.year_3_gift: How has this consistency transformed your relationships?

prompt.title: Hesitation
prompt.primary_question: What move are you thinking about but haven't made?
prompt.clarification: (What's the action? What's stopping you? Why now?)

gm_worldbuilding_hooks.geography: What action does your land need?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.social: What move threatens the power structure?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.history: What action would your ancestors take?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.magic: What portal opens if you move?

shadow_work.year_1_surface: What action are you sitting with?
shadow_work.year_2_shadow: What part of you refuses to move? Why?
shadow_work.year_3_gift: What has your hesitation been protecting or teaching?

prompt.title: Complicity
prompt.primary_question: Where are you comfortable because of injustice?
prompt.clarification: (REVISED: Concrete power analysis - what benefit do you receive?)

gm_worldbuilding_hooks.geography: What comfort does your land position give you?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.social: What system benefits do you quietly enjoy?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.history: What did your people gain from others' loss?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.magic: What becomes visible when you see this clearly?

shadow_work.year_1_surface: Where are you comfortable? Who isn't?
shadow_work.year_2_shadow: What would it cost you to change?
shadow_work.year_3_gift: What responsibility comes with your position?

prompt.title: Barrier
prompt.primary_question: What are you avoiding confronting?
prompt.clarification: (What external barrier? What fear? What consequence?)

gm_worldbuilding_hooks.geography: What does the landscape force you to confront?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.social: What power structure are you avoiding?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.history: What historical harm are you avoiding naming?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.magic: What threshold stands before you?

shadow_work.year_1_surface: What barrier stops you? Name it clearly.
shadow_work.year_2_shadow: What part of you created or accepted this barrier?
shadow_work.year_3_gift: How has your avoidance taught you about when to act and when to wait?

prompt.title: Sacrifice
prompt.primary_question: What would you have to give up to act?
prompt.clarification: (Relationship? Comfort? Status? Safety? Certainty?)

gm_worldbuilding_hooks.geography: What does acting cost this land? What does inaction?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.social: What relationships would be risked?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.history: What sacrifice did your ancestors make?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.magic: What becomes possible through sacrifice?

shadow_work.year_1_surface: What's the real cost? Be honest.
shadow_work.year_2_shadow: What part of you is willing? What part refuses?
shadow_work.year_3_gift: What have you learned about what matters most?

prompt.title: Consequence
prompt.primary_question: What consequence are you braced for?
prompt.clarification: (Retaliation? Loss? Isolation? Arrest? Failure?)

gm_worldbuilding_hooks.geography: What does this land do to those who act?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.social: What retaliation have you seen?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.history: What happened to people like you when they moved?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.magic: What protection is available?

shadow_work.year_1_surface: What are you most afraid of?
shadow_work.year_2_shadow: How are you exaggerating the consequence?
shadow_work.year_3_gift: How has facing this consequence changed you?

prompt.title: Betrayal
prompt.primary_question: Who might turn against you if you move?
prompt.clarification: (Who? What would break? What would they lose?)

gm_worldbuilding_hooks.geography: Who shares your geography but different stakes?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.social: Who benefits from keeping things as they are?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.history: What old betrayals is this echoing?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.magic: What relationships can transform through this?

shadow_work.year_1_surface: Who might you lose?
shadow_work.year_2_shadow: What part of you is willing to risk this? What part needs them too much?
shadow_work.year_3_gift: What relationships deepened or transformed?

prompt.title: Visibility
prompt.primary_question: What are you afraid of being seen doing?
prompt.clarification: (What exposure? What judgment? What risk?)

gm_worldbuilding_hooks.geography: Who can see you in this land?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.social: What visibility would compromise you?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.history: What did your people hide to survive?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.magic: What power comes with being seen?

shadow_work.year_1_surface: What could you be seen doing that terrifies you?
shadow_work.year_2_shadow: What about being visible activates your shame?
shadow_work.year_3_gift: How has visibility changed what you're capable of?

prompt.title: Witness
prompt.primary_question: Who do you need to see you act?
prompt.clarification: (Who gives you permission? Who needs to know? Who validates?)

gm_worldbuilding_hooks.geography: Who in this place can see you move?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.social: Who needs to witness this?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.history: Who from your past would be proud?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.magic: What becomes real when witnessed?

shadow_work.year_1_surface: Who do you need to see you?
shadow_work.year_2_shadow: What need for validation is underneath this?
shadow_work.year_3_gift: How has being witnessed transformed your capability?

prompt.title: Readiness
prompt.primary_question: What shifted so you're ready now?
prompt.clarification: (What changed in you? In the moment? In your community?)

gm_worldbuilding_hooks.geography: What seasonal shift made movement possible?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.social: What collective readiness are you feeling?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.history: What has been preparing you for this moment?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.magic: What threshold have you crossed?

shadow_work.year_1_surface: What made you ready?
shadow_work.year_2_shadow: What part of you became strong enough?
shadow_work.year_3_gift: How does recognizing your readiness change what's possible?

prompt.title: Body
prompt.primary_question: What does your body need to move?
prompt.clarification: (Rest? Fuel? Courage? Community? Permission? Rage?)

gm_worldbuilding_hooks.geography: What does your body need from this land to move?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.social: What community support does your body need?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.history: What trauma is your body holding?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.magic: What power awakens in your body?

shadow_work.year_1_surface: What does your body need?
shadow_work.year_2_shadow: What's your body protecting you from?
shadow_work.year_3_gift: How has moving changed what your body can do?

prompt.title: Disruption
prompt.primary_question: What are you willing to disrupt?
prompt.clarification: (What system? What comfort? What silence? What normal?)

gm_worldbuilding_hooks.geography: What in this land is calling to be disrupted?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.social: What normalized injustice will you interrupt?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.history: What pattern are you breaking?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.magic: What becomes possible through this disruption?

shadow_work.year_1_surface: What will you disrupt? With what?
shadow_work.year_2_shadow: What disruption in yourself must come first?
shadow_work.year_3_gift: What new patterns have grown from the disruption?

prompt.title: Continuity
prompt.primary_question: How will you keep moving when it gets hard?
prompt.clarification: (What sustains you? What community? What why?)

gm_worldbuilding_hooks.geography: What does the land offer to sustain long struggle?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.social: What community keeps you moving?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.history: What resilience did your people develop?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.magic: What practice returns you to center?

shadow_work.year_1_surface: What will keep you going?
shadow_work.year_2_shadow: What part of you wants to stop?
shadow_work.year_3_gift: How has sustained action changed what's possible?

prompt.title: Integration
prompt.primary_question: What does this action teach you about yourself?
prompt.clarification: (What did you discover? What became possible? What matters now?)

gm_worldbuilding_hooks.geography: What did acting teach you about your power in this place?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.social: What did you learn about yourself in community?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.history: What capacity did you reclaim?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.magic: What gift did your action open?

shadow_work.year_1_surface: What did this teach you?
shadow_work.year_2_shadow: Who did you become through this action?
shadow_work.year_3_gift: How does this action inform the next cycle?

prompt.title: Naming
prompt.primary_question: What have you been calling by the wrong name?
prompt.clarification: (What do you secretly know? What's the truth beneath the lie?)

gm_worldbuilding_hooks.geography: What does this land call by false names?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.social: What system is disguised as normal?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.history: What lie was taught about your people?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.magic: What true name wants to be spoken?

shadow_work.year_1_surface: What's been called wrong?
shadow_work.year_2_shadow: What did you choose not to see? Why?
shadow_work.year_3_gift: How has seeing clearly changed what you can do?

prompt.title: Collusion
prompt.primary_question: How have you been complicit in silencing?
prompt.clarification: (What silence have you kept? Why? Who benefits?)

gm_worldbuilding_hooks.geography: What does this land stay quiet about?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.social: What has your silence protected?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.history: What has your people been taught not to speak?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.magic: What truth is ready to emerge?

shadow_work.year_1_surface: How have you been quiet? Who does that serve?
shadow_work.year_2_shadow: What part of you chose complicity?
shadow_work.year_3_gift: What has breaking your silence made possible?

prompt.title: Truth
prompt.primary_question: What truth have you been avoiding saying?
prompt.clarification: (The dangerous thing? The unpopular thing? The secret thing?)

gm_worldbuilding_hooks.geography: What truth does this place hold that can't be spoken?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.social: What would change if this were said?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.history: What historical truth is being erased?
gm_worldbuilding_hooks.magic: What becomes possible when this is said?

shadow_work.year_1_surface: What's the truth?
shadow_work.year_2_shadow: What are you afraid will happen?
shadow_work.year_3_gift: How did naming this transform the conversation?

prompt.title: Impact
